Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 28

“But one who knows the truth about the divisions of quality and action, mighty-armed one, understands that qualities act upon qualities, and is not attached.”

Freedom comes from an accurate account rather than an effort of will. Seeing the machinery as machinery, one stops being personally implicated in every turn of it.
